<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex06012025-09-2610-48-46" status="reviewed" part="I" next="ex006012025-09-2611-10-52">
         <milestone unit="section" n="Incipit"/>
         <pb n="1b"/><lb n="1b1"/>
         <lg> <l>bder gshegs sras bcas chos kyi sku mnga' ba || </l>
         <l>phyag 'os kun la gus pas phyag 'tshal te ||</l>
         <l>rgyal sras <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3727">spyod la 'jug pa</rs>'i tshig dang don ||</l>
         <l>lung bzhin legs bshad rtogs pa dran phyir bri ||</l></lg>
         <note type="translation">Having bowed down respectfully to the Sugata together with his Sons, who possesses the body of the doctrine, and to all who are worth worshiping, I will write a correct explanation of the words and meaning of the “Entrance Gate into the Practice of the Sons of the Victorious One” in conformity with Scriptures, in order to remember (my) understanding.</note>
         </seg></TEI>
